descriptions.w3d_s20_trigger_effect_800e64e8: Appears to look up a resource key through a helper, prime an effect with constants 6 and 1 and start a second effect when the returned flag byte is nonzero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_check_then_count_8016b6d8: Appears to return a nonzero helper result unchanged, otherwise loop over an item's count field without per-element work and return 0.
descriptions.w3d_s20_init_global_object_8016f574: Appears to initialize a global object with a vtable, constants and links, register it with a helper and return 0.
